# `console/asbuilt.js`

[As built](../../README.md) › [As-built architecture mapping](../../subsystems/as-built-architecture-mapping.md) › `asbuilt.js`

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Renders the As-built tab: the codebase structure as analyzed by Fabrika, showing the system map with subsystems, capabilities, files and their relationships, read from `.fabrika/as-built/` with the ability to refresh when files change.

2,693 lines, in As-built architecture mapping.

## Parts

Too big to be one node, so shown in 9 parts: groups of its functions that call each other more than the rest of the file.

| Part | Lines | Functions | Largest | Calls out · in |
|---|---:|---:|---|---:|
| **File detail view** — Renders a single file's source code alongside its endpoints and parts, handling line highlighting, scrolling to a target line, and path display. Built around abFile and abSource for showing the content and abHiLine/abScrollSoon for jumping to a specific location. | 552 | 8 | `abFile` | 7 · 3 |
| **Folder diagram rendering** — Draws the interactive SVG folder/file tree used in the system map, building the folder model and layout, handling clicks and labels, and repainting or fitting the diagram as it changes. Centers on abFolderSvg and abFolderModel with abFolderPress/abFolderRepaint driving interaction. | 370 | 10 | `abFolderSvg` | 1 · 1 |
| **System map layout** — Computes the layout and connecting edges for the as-built system map, turning the file and subsystem data into positioned rows and drawn paths. abMap and abLayout establish the grid while abEdgePath/abEdgePathV route the connections between nodes. | 359 | 9 | `abMap` | 1 · 2 |
| **Overview tab assembly** — Builds the As-built tab's overview page: the capability grid, subsystem list, where-it-runs panel, and pagination, linking out to files and the editor. abOverview and abBody assemble the page while abCapGrid and abSubsList render its main sections. | 359 | 12 | `abOverview` | 2 · 12 |
| **Capability detail view** — Renders the detail view for a single capability, showing its owning subsystem, segments, and a progress meter on a plate-style card. Built around abCapability and abSubsystem with abMeter/abPlate handling the visuals. | 316 | 5 | `abCapability` | 5 · 2 |
| **Architecture map** — Shows the system at the runtime/architecture level, mapping which runtimes call which and identifying outside systems the codebase talks to. abArchMap and abArchitecture assemble the diagram, with abRuntimeOf/abCallsInRuntimes classifying the connections. | 267 | 5 | `abArchMap` | 4 · 0 |
| **Header band and staleness controls** — Renders the As-built tab's sticky header: the section title, a staleness pill when the analysis is out of date, and contextual help. abBand and asBuiltSection build the header while abStalePill and abStickyChrome manage its state as the page scrolls. | 181 | 8 | `abBand` | 1 · 1 |
| **Loading and normalizing as-built data** — Loads the as-built analysis from .fabrika/as-built/ and normalizes it into the shape the rest of the tab expects. asBuiltLoad fetches the data and abNormalize/abDerive reshape it for rendering. | 53 | 3 | `abNormalize` | 0 · 0 |
| **Analysis run status line** — Shows the status line reporting whether Fabrika's analysis is currently running or up to date. asBuiltRunLine and asBuiltRuns surface the run state, with asBuiltWorking/asBuiltNow tracking progress. | 44 | 5 | `asBuiltRunLine` | 0 · 0 |
